text: {"rules":[{"id":"STI-COUNSEL-B","version":"August 2020","title":"Behavioral counseling for sexually active adolescents and adults at increased risk for STIs","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends behavioral counseling for all sexually active adolescents and for adults who are at increased risk for sexually transmitted infections (STIs).","grade":"B","effective_date":"2020-08","action":"Provide behavioral counseling to prevent sexually transmitted infections","denominator":"{\"any\": [{\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"sexual activity status of an adolescent (adolescent age range not defined numerically in text)\"}, \"quote\": \"all sexually active adolescents\"}, {\"uncomputable\": {\"needs\": \"adult STI risk assessment (sexual behavior/exposure risk per Practice Considerations)\"}, \"quote\": \"adults who are at increased risk for sexually transmitted infections (STIs)\"}], \"quote\": \"for all sexually active adolescents and for adults who are at increased risk for sexually transmitted infections (STIs)\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"sti_behavioral_counseling\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"behavioral counseling\", \"derived\": {\"window\": \"text states no interval; a measurement-year window is assumed for checking and requires human approval\"}}","exclusions":"[]"}],"coverage_notes":["New concept 'sti_behavioral_counseling' used for the numerator; no vocabulary concept fits behavioral counseling for STI prevention.","Denominator is entirely uncomputable: sexual activity status and STI risk are sexual-behavior/exposure-risk information not reliably held in structured EHR data. The existing 'sexually_active' concept was not used per the requirement to treat sexual behavior as uncomputable.","The text does not define the age range for 'adolescents' vs 'adults'; no age criterion was encoded.","No counseling interval or frequency is stated; the measurement-year window in the numerator is an assumption flagged as derived.","Definition of populations at increased risk is deferred to the Practice Considerations section, which is not included in this section text.","Counseling content, intensity, and duration (behavioral intervention details) are not represented.","DATE field carries an asterisk ('August 2020 *') whose footnote meaning is not provided in the section text."]}
